title: Access
description: Who may use which app on solhann.net, and the record of every change. Grants are written here by a human and mirrored to the identity provider.

transition.data: Retain every existing canonical external-auth subject and grant row; no user or grant identifiers are rewritten.
transition.tokens: Keep the existing 30-minute non-renewable local sessions and server-side realtime expiry; provisioning restarts the app with the explicit marker before deploying the converged hook.
transition.rollback: Restore the pre-deploy PocketBase snapshot and previous protected identity files while retaining the existing OIDC triple; rerun live authorization and reconciliation before reopening changes.

rationale: It is the control plane for access to every other app: it writes the grant table, mirrors grants into Keycloak, ends people's sessions and disables accounts. Nothing here is invented data and nothing is low-consequence, so it is red and it is a platform repo rather than a wizard-generated app — the build agent has no grant on it.
